{{Top|leg}}
The '''Aft Deck Diner''' was a restaurant on the [[Bazaar Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. Its theme was "cheap eats from a dozen worlds," and it was known for its generous servings and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] cooking.
